5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.background: Linea runs weekend trains from Dublin to Galway and wants more couples and families to take them.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.objectives: Lift weekend return bookings by 12% over the summer.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.audience: Couples and young families in Dublin who drive west two or three weekends a year and arrive tired.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.insight: A drive is a job somebody has to do. A train journey is time somebody gives back to you.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.smp: The weekend starts when you sit down.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.desired_response: Think the train is quicker than I assumed. Feel the trip is part of the break. Book a weekend return.
5b0d3a7e-4c1f-4e2a-9a55-1d6c0f2b7e11.mandatories: Weekend return fare. No anti-car tone (shared regional partners).

finds.text: In travel forum threads about weekends west, the train ride itself is named as a highlight.
54% of rail passengers in a comparator market count the journey as part of the trip.
Your holiday starts here, not at the gate.
Dinner in 20 minutes. The rest of the evening is yours.
Your commute is now your favourite part of the day.
The story starts in the queue.

insights.text: Arriving tired is the worst part of the weekend.
A drive is a job somebody has to do; a train journey is time somebody gives back.
Rivals sell the destination; nobody sells the journey.
One person does every drive, and quietly resents it.
Most weekends are decided on a Friday.
People already call the train ride a highlight.
The holiday starts before you leave: lounges and queues sell the build-up.
What if the fare were the surprise, not the catch?
Meal kits sell the hour back.
Nobody wants to argue about the motorway.

crew.name: Close to the core
crew.heading: Stay on the proposition. Say it as plainly and truly as possible.

crew.name: Towards warmth
crew.heading: Go towards the feeling the brief points at: warm, sincere, family.

crew.name: The opposite pole
crew.heading: Go the other way from warmth: wry, loud, comic. Never mock drivers.

crew.name: Next door
crew.heading: Look at neighbouring categories and bring back a device.

crew.name: Far outside
crew.heading: Leap out of travel entirely: lounges, theme parks, cruises. Then come back.

way.text: Kept: arriving tired is the worst part

expeditions.turn: Stayed on the proposition. Every turn away from it was a job for another agent.

Turned hard away from warmth, and away from mocking drivers. It found the comedy in the driver's job, not the car.

expeditions.turn: Went furthest from the brief on purpose. One route came back usable; one is out in an unproven gap.

territories.name: Already Started
territories.thought: The weekend doesn't start at the hotel. It starts at Platform 4.
territories.why: The brief says the weekend starts when you sit down; this route makes that the whole story.
risks: SkyHop's 'The holiday starts at the gate' is close. Rail has to own the stronger version: two hours, not fifty minutes.
territories.sketch: The weekend doesn't start at the hotel. It starts at Platform 4.
territories.tension: The brief says the weekend starts when you sit down; this route makes that the whole story.

territories.name: Sit Down, It's Saturday
territories.thought: The proposition, said as plainly as it can be said.
territories.why: The safest reading of the brief. It may feel expected.
risks: Close to the brief, so it may feel expected.
territories.sketch: The proposition, said as plainly as it can be said.
territories.tension: The safest reading of the brief. It may feel expected.

territories.name: Sunday Night, Sorted
territories.thought: The best part of the train is the trip home. Sunday evening, no traffic, no dread.
territories.why: Most campaigns sell the way out. Nobody sells the way home.
risks: The weekend-return fare has to be clear or it reads as a one-way message.
territories.sketch: The best part of the train is the trip home. Sunday evening, no traffic, no dread.
territories.tension: Most campaigns sell the way out. Nobody sells the way home.

territories.name: Small Weekends
territories.thought: Not a holiday. Just a Saturday somewhere else, together.
territories.why: Families do not need a big trip; they need a reason to leave the house together.
risks: Small can read as unambitious. It needs one bold device.
territories.sketch: Not a holiday. Just a Saturday somewhere else, together.
territories.tension: Families do not need a big trip; they need a reason to leave the house together.

territories.name: Passenger Seat
territories.thought: For once, the person who always drives gets to be a passenger.
territories.why: One person does every drive; this gives them the weekend off.
risks: Rests partly on a finding the agent derived and nobody has verified yet.
Must not mock drivers (partners' no-anti-car rule).
territories.sketch: For once, the person who always drives gets to be a passenger.
territories.tension: One person does every drive; this gives them the weekend off.

territories.name: The Lonely Motorway
territories.thought: The motorway, played as a character, misses the families who left it for the train.
territories.why: Turns the one driver's job into comedy without blaming the car.
risks: Close to the no-anti-car line: the motorway is sad, never the car blamed. Review flags it.
territories.sketch: The motorway, played as a character, misses the families who left it for the train.
territories.tension: Turns the one driver's job into comedy without blaming the car.

territories.name: Weekend Mixtape
territories.thought: Every route west gets its own playlist. The train is the opening track of the weekend.
territories.why: Borrows the mixtape's ritual: the journey is the first song.
risks: Music licensing for the playlists is an open question for the client.
territories.sketch: Every route west gets its own playlist. The train is the opening track of the weekend.
territories.tension: Borrows the mixtape's ritual: the journey is the first song.

territories.name: Departure Lounge
territories.thought: Platform 4 is the weekend's departure lounge: the holiday starts before the train moves.
territories.why: Airport lounges sell the build-up; the train can do it without the wait.
risks: SkyHop's 'The holiday starts at the gate' is the same thought. Rail must own it with the two-hour journey, not the wait.
territories.sketch: Platform 4 is the weekend's departure lounge: the holiday starts before the train moves.
territories.tension: Airport lounges sell the build-up; the train can do it without the wait.

territories.name: Breakfast From Platform 4
territories.thought: Borrow the hotel ritual: the weekend begins with breakfast on board.
territories.why: Meal kits sell the hour back; breakfast sells the first hour of the weekend.
risks: Needs on-board catering at weekends. Ask the client.
territories.sketch: Borrow the hotel ritual: the weekend begins with breakfast on board.
territories.tension: Meal kits sell the hour back; breakfast sells the first hour of the weekend.

territories.name: The Ride Before the Ride
territories.thought: Like a theme-park queue, the build-up is half the fun.
territories.why: Far from rail; the theme-park device must stay a metaphor.
risks: Rests on no evidence yet. This direction is unproven.
territories.sketch: Like a theme-park queue, the build-up is half the fun.
territories.tension: Far from rail; the theme-park device must stay a metaphor.

territories.name: Motorway Anonymous
territories.thought: A support group for people recovering from years of Friday traffic.
territories.sketch: A support group for people recovering from years of Friday traffic.
territories.kill_reason: Funny, but it leaves the proposition behind: it no longer says the weekend starts when you sit down.

territories.name: The Motorway Complains
territories.thought: The motorway, played as a grumpy host, grumbles about the families who left.
risks: Too close to Passenger Seat: both hand the driver the weekend off.
territories.sketch: The motorway, played as a grumpy host, grumbles about the families who left.

actions.text: Two routes sat close together; The Motorway Complains was moved outward and its first version is parked.
Nobody had explored far outside the brief, so an agent was sent there.
